name: Moana
description: In Disney's live-action reimagining of the beloved animated adventure, Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef to save her people.
critics_consensus: The sea calls to no one in this underwhelming new version of Moana, an endeavor that solidifies its animated predecessor as the superior adventure.

name: The Odyssey
description: Odysseus, king of Ithaca, embarks on a perilous journey to return home after the Trojan War, facing mythical creatures and impossible trials along the way.
critics_consensus: Reinvigorating an ancient adventure with majestic sweep and sterling work by its colossal ensemble, Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey imbues myth with primal human feeling.

name: Evil Dead Burn
description: Evil Dead Burn unleashes the franchise's most savage and terrifying ride to date, blazing onto big screens with an all-new chapter of carnage and demonic horror.
critics_consensus: Sébastien Vaniček spills guts with glory in this latest installment of Evil Dead, featuring the meanest, nastiest, and ickiest chapter that is sure to leave fans with a wickedly satisfying Burn for more.

name: The Invite
description: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors over for dinner, the evening spirals into unexpected and increasingly bizarre events.
critics_consensus: Perversely funny while giving its quartet of fine actors some of their best material yet, The Invite is a sophisticated farce that reaffirms Olivia Wilde as one of the most exciting filmmakers working today.

name: Obsession
description: A hopeless romantic's wish comes true in the worst possible way, turning an ideal romance into a disturbing nightmare as obsession spirals out of control.
critics_consensus: Taking an icky conceit and twisting it to deviously crowd-pleasing ends, Obsession is dauntingly disturbing while also skillfully amusing and thrilling.
